## Motivation & Problem Statement

Describe the hardware platform, bootloader requirement, or builder feature you would like to see supported.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the proposed implementation, target profile, or architectural improvement.

## Category

Select all that apply:

- [ ] New Board & Target Support (New SoC, device DTS, board profile)
- [ ] Bootloader Features (lk2nd / lk1st enhancements, display support, fastboot modes)
- [ ] Packaging & Flashing (Boot image wrapping, flashing scripts, payload formats)
- [ ] Docker & Cross-Toolchain (New architectures, container workflow improvements)
- [ ] Documentation & Guides

## Proposed Usage Syntax

```bash
# Example of how the new feature or profile should be invoked
make build TARGET=<target-name>
```

## Additional Context

Add hardware specifications, serial/EDL logs, reference schematics, or links to upstream documentation.
